bibl.title: Of Pots, Sherds, and Drachmas. Demotic Ostraca from Ḥw.t-Rpy.t (with a Detour to Soknopaiou Nesos).
bibl.seg: Sandra Lippert, Of Pots, Sherds, and Drachmas. Demotic Ostraca from Ḥw.t-Rpy.t (with a Detour to Soknopaiou Nesos).

Franziska Naether (ed.), New Approaches in Demotic Studies. Acts of the 13th International Conference of Demotic Studies = Zeitschrift für ägyptische Sprache und Altertumskunde. Beiheft 10 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 151-174, figg.
bibl.note: Thousands of mostly Demotic ostraca were found since 2003 by a German-Egyptian mission at Ḥw.t-Rpy.t / Τριφεῖον (near Sohag), near the temple of Ptolemy XII. The focus of this article lies on a few "new" demotic words from them. - 1. A new Demotic wine measure. - 2. A key word on wine jar labels. - 3. A writing for the silver drachma?
